name: Web
description: Search the web with a search engine of your choice, read pages and documents, and follow RSS and Atom feeds. Every search asks you first with the exact query (you can edit it); reading a page asks unless the site is on your allowed list. Read only, capped per reply, and every request is logged in Data > Web log.

settings.name: searchUrl
settings.label: Search address
settings.description: The results page Seven loads for a search, with {query} where the search words go, e.g. https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q={query} or https://www.bing.com/search?q={query}. Add the engine's own options (safe search, region) to the address.

settings.name: allowedSites
settings.label: Allowed sites
settings.description: Sites pages can be read from without asking, separated by commas: e.g. dndbeyond.com, *.wikipedia.org. Searches always ask.
